'''Tropical Curry''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It can be purchased from [[Leo]]'s [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] during the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|30|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s.

'''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.

==Tailoring==
Tropical Curry is used in the spool of a [[Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Tropical Sunrise Shirt]]. [[File:Tropical Sunrise Shirt.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
